newsitem.title: USA: Borders Group reiterates 97 EPS of $1.80.
newsitem.headline: Borders Group reiterates 97 EPS of $1.80.

text.p: Borders Group Inc said Tuesday it is reiterating its earnings guidance for 1997 of $1.80 per share, or $0.90 per share after giving effect to a 2-for-1 stock split set earlier this year.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report earnings of $1.80 for the next fiscal year, according to First Call consensus estimates.
Earlier Tuesday the company reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.82 per share on sales of $727.0 million, compared to earnings of $0.66 per share on sales of $669.5 million in the year-ago period.
